title: Lost hiker meets a woman who went missing a decade earlier

tellings.quote: The description fits to someone who went lost went missing there like a decade or more ago

plain: A hiker lost in a forest in the United States is said to have met a woman whose description matched someone who had gone missing in that same place a decade or more earlier. The researcher Jason Jorjani tells it on the show, passing on what a man named David Pitus told him, and ties it to Missing 411, a collection of cases about people who vanish in the wild. If it were true, it would mean some people who disappear out there do not simply die but turn up somewhere, years later.
